source_selection: Requested release contains only example caches. Sibling source project matches the bundled example provenance; both example NPZ SHA-256 values match.
npz_payloads: All 430 NPZ files are byte-for-byte identical to SSH source files.

coverage.filename_policy: Original filenames retained. No cache generated, renamed or filled to hide missing canonical inputs.
coverage.preflight: Requires the 214 canonical cache pairs with their archived hashes and preserves the existing no-cache fallback for exactly the three documented canonical IDs. Unexpected missing or replacement caches are rejected.

historical_score_observation.interpretation: Consistent with the historical loader missing-cache fallback; not a new GPU reproduction. Resolving an alias or rebuilding missing caches can change the historical inputs.

metadata_processing.change: Only absolute cluster path prefixes were removed from metadata path strings, leaving source-project-relative paths. Scientific parameter values were retained.

historical_fallback_policy.msa: Uniform log probabilities and zero feature/availability/reliability arrays and log Neff.
historical_fallback_policy.teacher: Uniform log probabilities and zero availability/reliability; substitution log-probability differences are zero.
